title: NMN (Nicotinamide Mononucleotide): FDA Drug Preclusion Reversal & Supplement Status
excerpt: After a three-year regulatory battle, the FDA reversed its drug preclusion determination for NMN in September 2025, confirming it is lawful in dietary supplements. Here is everything regulatory professionals need to know.
seo_title: NMN FDA Status 2026: Drug Preclusion Reversal, NPA Lawsuit & NDI Requirements
seo_description: Complete regulatory intelligence on NMN (nicotinamide mononucleotide). FDA reversed its drug preclusion ruling in September 2025. NDI notification requirements, international status, and compliance guidance for supplement companies.
